zxv.name: MODE
zxv.signature: MODE(m as UByte, w as UInteger = 0, h as UInteger = 0)
zxv.doc: MODE n[, w, h]: mode 0 (256 x 192, 32 x 24 characters) or 1 (512 x 384). In mode 0 the page can be bigger than the screen (512 x 384, 1024 x 192 or 256 x 768), and SCROLL moves the screen over it. Both pages are cleared, page 0 is shown and drawn on, and the scroll, REMAP and CLIP go.

zxv.name: PAGE
zxv.doc: PAGE n: the page that is shown (0 or 1)

zxv.name: SCREEN
zxv.doc: SCREEN n: the page everything draws on. Drawing on the hidden one and then showing it gives animations without flicker.

zxv.name: SCROLL
zxv.signature: SCROLL(x as Integer = 0, y as Integer = 0)
zxv.doc: SCROLL x, y: the pixel (x, y) of the page is seen at the top left corner of the screen; SCROLL alone puts it back

zxv.name: REMAP
zxv.signature: REMAP(c as UByte, n as UByte)
zxv.doc: REMAP c, n: colour c is seen as n, at once and on all the screen

zxv.name: REMAPRESET
zxv.doc: REMAPRESET: every colour as it was (REMAP with no arguments)

zxv.name: WAIT
zxv.doc: WAIT [n]: until the next frame, and until n frames have gone since the last WAIT: a steady pace for games

zxv.name: GRAB
zxv.signature: GRAB(n as UByte, x as Integer, y as Integer, w as UInteger, h as UInteger, t as Integer = -1)
zxv.doc: GRAB n, x, y, w, h[, t]: sprite n (0-255) is that rectangle of the drawing page; colour t becomes transparent

zxv.name: GRABSTR
zxv.signature: GRABSTR(n as UByte, w as UInteger, ByVal a$ as String)
zxv.doc: GRABSTR n, w, a$: sprite n from a string, a character a pixel and w pixels a row: the hex digits are the colours, anything else (".", " ") is transparent

zxv.name: SPRITE
zxv.signature: SPRITE(n as UByte, x as Integer, y as Integer, f as UByte = 0, ByVal c$ as String = "", w as UInteger = 0, h as UInteger = 0)
zxv.doc: SPRITE n, x, y[, f[, c$[, w, h]]]: draws sprite n with its top left corner at (x, y). f: 1 mirrored left to right, 2 upside down, 3 both. c$ changes its colours: colour i is drawn as the hex digit i of c$ (any other character leaves it). w, h: stretched or shrunk to that size.

zxv.name: HIT
zxv.signature: HIT(a as UByte, ax as Integer, ay as Integer, b as UByte, bx as Integer, by as Integer) as UByte
zxv.doc: HIT(a, ax, ay, b, bx, by): 1 if a solid pixel of sprite a at (ax, ay) falls on a solid pixel of sprite b at (bx, by); it draws nothing

zxv.name: BOX
zxv.signature: BOX(c as UByte, x as Integer, y as Integer, w as Integer, h as Integer)
zxv.doc: BOX c, x, y, w, h: a filled rectangle of colour c

zxv.name: DISC
zxv.signature: DISC(c as UByte, x as Integer, y as Integer, r as Integer)
zxv.doc: DISC c, x, y, r: a filled circle

zxv.name: POLY
zxv.signature: POLY(c as UByte, x1 as Integer, y1 as Integer, x2 as Integer = -32768, y2 as Integer = 0, x3 as Integer = -32768, y3 as Integer = 0, x4 as Integer = -32768, y4 as Integer = 0, x5 as Integer = -32768, y5 as Integer = 0, x6 as Integer = -32768, y6 as Integer = 0, x7 as Integer = -32768, y7 as Integer = 0, x8 as Integer = -32768, y8 as Integer = 0)
zxv.doc: POLY c, x1, y1[, x2, y2...]: a point, a line or a filled polygon (up to 8 points)

zxv.name: CLIP
zxv.signature: CLIP(x as Integer = 0, y as Integer = 0, w as Integer = -1, h as Integer = 0)
zxv.doc: CLIP x, y, w, h: the fast graphics only draw in that rectangle; CLIP alone, everywhere

zxv.name: PIXEL
zxv.signature: PIXEL(x as Integer, y as Integer) as Byte
zxv.doc: PIXEL(x, y): the colour (0-15) of a pixel of the drawing page, whoever drew it; -1 out of the page

zxv.name: KEY
zxv.doc: KEY(n): 1 if the key is down now (several at once). n: CODE "a" to CODE "z", CODE "0" to CODE "9", 8 to 11 the cursor keys (left, right, down, up), 12 Delete, 13 Enter, 32 Space, or 256 + a USB key code

zxv.name: JOY
zxv.doc: JOY(n): the buttons of joystick n (0 or 1); 0 if it is not connected. 1 right, 2 left, 4 down, 8 up, 16 fire 1, 32 fire 2, 64 fire 3, 128 start, 256 select

zxv.name: SOUND
zxv.signature: SOUND(r as UByte, v as UByte)
zxv.doc: SOUND r, v: writes v in register r of the AY chips (0-15 the first, 16-31 the second)

zxv.name: TIME
zxv.doc: TIME: the frames (60 a second) since the machine started

zxv.name: MUSICLOAD
zxv.doc: MUSICLOAD f$: loads a module made with a tracker (without an extension, f$.pt3): Pro Tracker 3 or Vortex Tracker II (.pt3, what zxv-tracker saves), a TurboSound (two modules, one on each AY chip), Pro Tracker 2, Sound Tracker, ASC Sound Master or a PSG dump. It goes in the heap.

zxv.name: MUSICPLAY
zxv.doc: MUSICPLAY: plays the module in the background while the program goes on, and at its end goes back to its loop position, for ever. It plays on the first AY chip (a TurboSound, on both), until MUSICSTOP or the end of the program.

zxv.name: MUSICSTOP
zxv.doc: MUSICSTOP: stops the music

zxv.name: MUSICPAUSE
zxv.doc: MUSICPAUSE: silences the music; MUSICCONTINUE goes on where it was

zxv.name: MUSIC
zxv.doc: MUSIC: 1 while the music plays, 0 if not

zxv.name: SFXLOAD
zxv.doc: SFXLOAD f$: loads an AYFX bank of sound effects (without an extension, f$.afb: what the effects tab of zxv-tracker or the AY Sound FX Editor saves), or a single effect (.afx). It goes in the heap.

zxv.name: SFX
zxv.signature: SFX(n as UByte, c as Byte = -1)
zxv.doc: SFX n[, c]: plays effect n of the bank (the first is 0) without waiting, on a free channel of the chip the music does not use, or on channel c: 0 to 2 are A, B and C of the first chip and 3 to 5 those of the second

zxv.name: SFXSTOP
zxv.doc: SFXSTOP: stops all the effects

zxv.name: SFXPLAYING
zxv.doc: SFXPLAYING: 1 while any effect plays
